title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: St Augustine Amphitheatre, St Augustine | 2025
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the St Augustine Amphitheatre in St Augustine, Florida, USA, on 22 June 2025.

It was the eighth show of the 16th All-Starr Band’s 2025 tour. Starr had previously performed at the St Augustine Amphitheatre on 17 July 2010, 29 June 2012, and 15 September 2022.

The 16th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Buck Johnson: vocals, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
